findings.summary: The plan bans the backtest link phrases only next to a decision id, but the backtest also fails on a phrase with no id after it.
findings.evidence: crates/athena-cli/src/backtest.rs:144-158: when 'amends', 'supersedes' or 'superseded by' appears with no target id after it and `opens_statement` holds for the text before it, the line goes into `lacking_target`. tests/backtest.rs:126-130 asserts `lacking_target` is empty for the real log. The plan only bans the phrases 'next to a decision id', so a sentence like 'D155 amends nothing in section 7' could still fail the test. Fix: Tell the producer not to use 'amends', 'supersedes' or 'superseded by' anywhere in D155, with or without an id. Use 'extends' or 'builds on' instead.
findings.location: Decision 5 / Step 9 / Dependents entry for docs/decisions.md

findings.summary: The plan should say D155 goes at the very end of docs/decisions.md, because the confirmed links are keyed by line number.
findings.evidence: The confirmed links in the backtest are keyed by line number (tests/backtest.rs:146-149, e.g. line 322, 1028, 1760, 1909). Appending after D154 (decisions.md:4213) shifts none of them, but inserting anywhere earlier would. Fix: Say that D155 goes at the very end of docs/decisions.md, so no earlier line number moves.

summary: Round 3 is sound. I checked the code it cites against the snapshot. `rebuild_due` is set at drain.rs:1726, set to false at 2369 and taken at 2404. `rebuild_if_due` is at 2402 and its one caller is at 2431. `ItemEnd::Waiting` is at 1860 and is passed over at 2511. `landing_from_report` is at 3136. The backtest phrase list is at backtest.rs:78-82, and the newest decision is D154 at decisions.md:4213, so D155 is the right next id. The design keeps the rebuild's lock invariant. It reuses the existing REST merge instead of depending on host auto-merge. It bounds head-of-line blocking with a time limit H and sends a refused merge to the user at once. It treats the 420.0 min as a prediction and makes measuring the time per phase the first build job. That answers the earlier soundness concerns and is not guesswork. The demonstrations are content checks of a docs-only change plus `cargo test --locked`, which is the right seam. The dependents cover the decisions.md readers, the CHANGELOG include_str! tests, the policy scan and the budgets. The conflict between criterion 8 and the deliverables list (decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md sit outside docs/design/) is raised as an open question for the user. I have two minor points, neither blocking. First, the backtest also fails when one of the three link phrases appears with no decision id after it, so the ban should cover the phrases outright. Second, D155 must go at the very end of decisions.md so the line-keyed confirmed links do not move.
